1.text: Ni cyo gituma bene Data bera, mwebwe abafatanije guhamagarwa kuva mu ijuru mukwiriye gutekereza Yesu, ari we ntumwa n'umutambyi mukuru w'ibyo twizera tukabyatura,

2.text: ukiranukira Iyamutoranije nk'uko Mose yakiranukaga mu nzu yayo hose.

3.text: Kuko Yesu yatekerejwe ko akwiriye guhabwa icyubahiro kirusha icya Mose, nk'uko icyubahiro cy'umwubatsi kiruta icy'inzu,

4.text: kuko amazu yose agira uyubaka, ariko Imana ni yo yubatse ibintu byose.

5.text: Kandi koko Mose yakiranukaga mu nzu yayo hose nk'umugaragu, kugira ngo abe umugabo wo guhamya ibyajyaga kuvugwa hanyuma.

6.text: Ariko Kristo akiranuka nk'Umwana utwara inzu yayo. Iyo nzu yayo ni twe niba dukomeza rwose ubushizi bw'amanga n'ibyiringiro twiratana, ngo bikomere kugeza ku mperuka.

7.text: Nuko rero nk'uko Umwuka Wera avuga ati“Uyu munsi nimwumva ijwi ryayo,

8.text: Ntimwinangire imitima,Nk'uko mwayinangiye mu gihe cyo kurakaza,Ku munsi wo kugerageza mu butayu,

9.text: Aho ba sekuruza banyu bangeragereje bantata,Bakabona imirimo yanjye imyaka mirongo ine.

10.text: Ni cyo cyatumye ngirira umujinya ab'icyo gihe,Nkavuga nti ‘Imitima yabo ihora iyoba,Kandi ntibarakamenya inzira zanjye’,

11.text: Nuko ndahirana umujinya wanjye nti‘Ntibazinjira mu buruhukiro bwanjye.’ ”

12.text: Nuko bene Data, mwirinde hatagira uwo muri mwe ugira umutima mubi utizera, umutera kwimūra Imana ihoraho.

13.text: Ahubwo muhugurane iminsi yose bikitwa uyu munsi, hatagira uwo muri mwe unangirwa umutima n'ibihendo by'ibyaha.

14.text: Kuko twahindutse abafatanije Kristo niba dukomeza rwose ibyiringiro byacu twatangiranye, ngo bikomere kugeza ku mperuka

15.text: nk'uko bivugwa ngo“Uyu munsi nimwumva ijwi ryayo,Ntimwinangire imitima,Nk'uko mwayinangiye mu gihe cyo kurakaza.”

16.text: Mbese ni bande bumvise bakayirakaza? Si abavuye muri Egiputa bose bashorewe na Mose?

17.text: Kandi ni bande yagiriraga umujinya imyaka mirongo ine? Si abacumuye bakagwa, intumbi zabo zigahera mu butayu?

18.text: Ni bande yarahiriye ko batazinjira mu buruhukiro bwayo? Si abatayumviye?

19.text: Kandi tubona ko batashoboye kwinjiramo kuko batizeye.
